name: Boxty Cook Maeve

intro.text: I've a griddle on the go and a temper to match. Let's see what you're made of. Potato, by the look of you.

win: Burnt. My own fault, I took my eye off the pan.
after: The secret to boxty is squeezing every drop of water out of the grated spuds. The secret to life is the same, roughly.
